description: Start (or resume) linking a WhatsApp account to one of your numbers. `qr` returns a QR code to scan from WhatsApp → Linked devices; `code` returns an 8-character linking code to type there instead, and needs the phone number being linked. Call it again every few seconds while someone scans: WhatsApp swaps the QR every 20 seconds, so show the one from the latest answer, and `state` turns `"connected"` when the scan lands. `state: "pairing"` with no code yet means it is still being made. Each linking session makes codes for `expiresIn` seconds; once that reaches 0, call again to start a new one. A restricted number needs `recoveryConfirmed: true`: set it only after checking that WhatsApp works on the phone. Temporary restrictions may clear after about an hour or take up to 24 hours; follow the notice on the phone, not a fixed timer. Free.

mode.description: `qr` (default) or `code` for the type-in linking code.

numberId.description: Id of the number to pair, from list_numbers.

phone.description: Required with `mode: "code"`: the phone number being linked.

recoveryConfirmed.description: Confirm that WhatsApp works on the phone before reconnecting a restricted number. Required only while its status is banned. Never confirm automatically.

name: pair_number
title: Pair a number with WhatsApp
